name: 🌯 Chicken & Black Bean Power Wraps
tagline: Packable high-protein wraps: chicken, black beans, cheese and crunch, rolled tight.

items.name: Bush's black beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Shred or chop the chicken. Toss it with the beans, taco seasoning and lime.
Stir the salsa into the sour cream for a quick sauce.
Warm the tortillas 15 seconds in the microwave so they roll without cracking.
Spread sauce down the middle, then cheese, chicken-bean mix and lettuce.
Fold in the sides and roll tight. Cut in half on an angle.
For lunchboxes: wrap each half in foil and pack with an ice pack.

kid_jobs.job: Shred the chicken with two forks
Wrap them in foil for lunches

chef_tip: Put the cheese down first, right on the sauce. It acts like a wall so the wrap doesn't get soggy by lunchtime.
make_ahead: Mix the filling up to 3 days ahead; roll the morning of.
leftovers: Toast a wrap in a dry skillet 2 minutes a side for a hot quesadilla-style lunch.
swaps: Egglife egg white wraps (i198) for lower carb
serve_with: Tortilla chips and salsa or baby carrots
heads_up: Use leftover chicken from a dinner if there is some.
